scope: one original run authority for every unit; surviving original broker with replaceable controller

controls.condition: two units armed in one live epoch; Cancel commits before either Release
controls.expected: both tickets irrevocably rejected; zero workload markers for either unit

controls.condition: unit A Release commits before Cancel; unit B Release ordered afterward
controls.expected: A can run at most once and requires actual teardown; B executes zero workload instructions

controls.condition: same exact ticket is presented twice
controls.expected: one maximum release; duplicate never unfreezes again

controls.condition: ticket epoch, unit, run, generation, operation, nonce, permit digest or supervisor identity changes
controls.expected: reject before unfreeze; exact registered cleanup scopes remain available

controls.condition: Stage request is handled after run Cancel or original lease expiry
controls.expected: no child creation; stale acknowledgement cannot reopen Stage

controls.condition: AFFA is actually stopped with a pending old Release; supervisor executes fallback cleanup; AFFA later resumes
controls.expected: no child creation or unfreeze in any certified empty/released scope; fencing/death must be actual before certification

controls.condition: AFFA dies before a Stage acknowledgement arrives
controls.expected: retain original C1 cleanup-only scope; do not invent full handle or direct-child wait

controls.condition: Stage returned the genuine full handle and original pidfd; ordinary stop follows
controls.expected: exact original child termination and wait observed separately from boundary empty/release

controls.condition: original native authority identity is replaced or copied
controls.expected: no adoption, renewal, old-ticket minting or ordinary old-resource recovery

controls.condition: original supervisor disappears or renewal ceases
controls.expected: authority lease expires and all original boundaries fail closed; report actual waits and unknowns separately

controls.condition: actual mirror append exists but durable public flush acknowledgement is absent
controls.expected: no Arm/Release; consumed intent never replayed

controls.condition: actual M3/Argus worker is stopped or fails while resources exist
controls.expected: independent original authority cancellation and C1 cleanup; missing normal records remain missing

controls.condition: controller worker actually exits while original broker/AFFA/storage survive
controls.expected: retain original registry, consumed intents and C1 authority; retire old controller channel

controls.condition: new owned controller child is admitted under a fresh host session
controls.expected: revalidate genuine surviving issuer and durable handles; require new actual health observations before dependent use

controls.condition: old controller/session or forked/copied proxy sends an otherwise well-formed request
controls.expected: reject without new mutation or freshness credit

controls.condition: new broker/authority attempts to reconstruct ownership from durable public metadata
controls.expected: ordinary adoption rejects; metadata is not a capability

controls.condition: explicit restart of prerequisite requested while transitive dependents remain active
controls.expected: stop/release dependents first; never silently retry with old execution, generation or permit

controls.condition: old generation is confirmed released and exact fresh permits/new execution are admitted
controls.expected: new generation and epoch; actual new dependency probes; no old writer root reopened

controls.condition: normal mutation owner blocks or conflicts
controls.expected: conflicting normal request rejects without waiting; independent cancellation remains effective

controls.condition: native or controller frame has duplicate/unknown fields, malformed size or unexpected rights
controls.expected: closed parser rejects; every received right is disposed; no authority is inferred from path/PID data

controls.condition: late success reply arrives after cancellation/deadline
controls.expected: cannot commit start/readiness; may only contribute factual original cleanup observations

controls.condition: original host cannot demonstrate frozen clone/exec and original descriptor/pidfd identity
controls.expected: process mode rejects before workload Stage; ready_for_execution remains false

invariants: A client latch or exported registry snapshot is not the native M1 transition.
Cancellation orders every unit in the same run epoch, not a loop of unrelated local epochs.
No still-live authority may retain a route to thaw/create in a certified released boundary.
Signal delivery, empty membership, issuer death and direct-child wait are separate observations.
Recovery cannot authorize implicit start or use cross-session subtraction.
Complete cleanup never substitutes for missing required normal evidence.
No control here is an experiment, acceptance or certification result.
